name: Box-Fort Brigade

tracks.title: Box-Fort Brigade - main theme
tracks.style_prompt: Energetic chiptune-meets-modern arcade electronic, playful and urgent, miniature cardboard fort physics siege atmosphere, Synth Lead, Synth Bass, Drums, Arpeggiator, Synth Keys, 140 BPM, memorable repeating melodic motif, instrumental, no vocals, dynamic game soundtrack score, seamless looping structure
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(sparse ambient layer, quiet pulse)
[Verse 1 - Exploration Layer]
(light Synth Bass and Arpeggiator, relaxed Drums)
[Pre-Chorus - Tension Build]
(rising Synth Lead, Snare build)
[Chorus - Combat Layer]
(full Drums, driving Synth Bass, bright Synth Lead)
[Bridge - Danger / Boss State]
(fast minor Arpeggiator, urgent Kick pattern)
[Outro]
(resolution back to ambient loop tail)
tracks.notes: Exported 32-bar loop (bars 7-39, 12.00s-66.86s, 54.86s, 2633143 frames @ 48kHz 24-bit) via SonicAlchemist export-adaptive.exe with 0.85s fade-in/fade-out clip envelopes (seam_step <= 0.000003). Integrated into /Game/Audio/Music/SW_Music_*_v001 with 4 states (Explore, Tension, Combat, Boss).
